mentions.name: tiny-dfr fork (keloran/tiny-dfr)
mentions.description: A fork of tiny-dfr that makes the 2019 MacBook Pro touchbar usable as a dynamic function row when running the hyprland and COSMIC Linux compositors.
mentions.problem: The 2019 MacBook Pro touchbar is useless when running hyprland or COSMIC.
mentions.source_excerpt:
This month I have mainly been building my fork of tiny-dfr so that my 2019 mbp touchbar isn’t useless when on hyprland/cosmic

https://github.com/keloran/tiny-dfr
